cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Enjoy your afternoon off. Your bike will be ready for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's the repair shop asking me to collect a wheel?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. They've got your number on the ticket. I'll collect everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A wheel? Is the rest at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until four. Stay with your book; I've planned a route that gets all of it home before you need it.

mechanism: A treats handling repair complications alone as a lesson in allowing oneself rest, keeping a pupil free from the practical burden.
confusable: A hides logistics out of care, not to pass the task to B or avoid its own responsibility.
comparison: Sleep after care work versus protecting a rare free afternoon.
seedUse: Use D39 bike parts at shops/four/reading; S05 credit for noticing paperwork and insistence on delegated care maintain teacher posture.
